_comment: The Sky view's corpus: the day read for everyone, from the aspects the planets make to one another. Pairs are keyed First|Tone|Second, the faster planet first (Moon, then Sun to Pluto); Tone is Conjunction, Flow (sextile, trine) or Tension (square, opposition). The Sun-Moon aspects are the lunar phases, in daily.json. The Moon, phases, stations, retrogrades, calendar events and planetary days are also read from daily.json.

pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Mercury: Feelings and words run together: people talk about how they feel, and news travels on mood more than on fact for a few hours.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Mercury: Conversation comes easily. It is a good stretch for messages, errands and sorting things out with other people.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Mercury: Head and heart pull apart for a few hours: replies come out sharper or more anxious than meant, and misunderstandings spread quickly.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Venus: A warm, sociable few hours. People are inclined to be pleasant, to spend a little, and to look for comfort and company.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Venus: Goodwill is easy to find. Small kindnesses, shared meals and making things look nice go down well.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Venus: Appetites run ahead of good sense for a few hours: indulgence, small jealousies and spending on impulse are common.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Mars: Tempers and energy rise together. People act on feeling, quickly, and small irritations flare.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Mars: Feeling and action line up: a brisk stretch for physical jobs and for saying plainly what is wanted.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Mars: Short fuses for a few hours. Impatience, sharp words and rushed moves are likely, on the roads as much as anywhere.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Jupiter: The mood lifts and grows expansive. Generosity, optimism and overdoing it all come more easily.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Jupiter: A hopeful, good-humoured stretch. People give each other the benefit of the doubt, and help is easier to ask for.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Jupiter: Moods run large: promises outrun what can be delivered, and excess in food, spending or opinions is tempting.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Saturn: The mood sobers. Duties and limits weigh more, and a cooler, more reserved tone sets in for a while.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Saturn: Steady and dependable: a good stretch for routine work, keeping promises and dealing with what is practical.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Saturn: A heavier few hours. Discouragement, coldness or obstacles weigh on the mood, and things feel slower than they are.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Uranus: The mood jumps. Restlessness, surprises and sudden changes of plan are common, and routine feels confining.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Uranus: A lively, open-minded stretch. People welcome something new and take small changes in their stride.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Uranus: Nerves are jumpy and plans change at short notice. Expect interruptions, and leave room for the unexpected.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Neptune: The mood softens and drifts. Sympathy runs high, but so do daydreams, vagueness and things left unclear.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Neptune: A gentle, imaginative stretch, kind to music, rest, art and quiet compassion.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Neptune: Things are hazier than they seem for a few hours: confusion, wishful thinking and mixed signals are common.
pairs.Moon|Conjunction|Pluto: Feelings run deep and intense. Undercurrents surface, and people are less willing to let things go.
pairs.Moon|Flow|Pluto: A focused, probing stretch, good for getting to the bottom of something or clearing out what is no longer needed.
pairs.Moon|Tension|Pluto: Emotional pressure builds. Control, suspicion and struggles over who decides come closer to the surface for a few hours.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Mercury: Mercury passes the Sun, a turning point in its cycle. Thinking is tightly bound to purpose, which helps conviction but makes blind spots hard to see.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Venus: Venus passes the Sun, a turning point in her cycle. Questions of value, affection and what people find worth having come forward, and a new chapter in them begins.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Mars: The Sun and Mars together raise the heat. Ambition, competition and the urge to act are strong; much gets started, some of it in anger.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Mars: Purpose and energy work together. Effort pays off, people are willing to take the initiative, and physical work goes well.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Mars: Will collides with will. Disputes, impatience and contests of strength are more common, and mishaps come from haste.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Jupiter: A high point of confidence in the year. Optimism, generosity and large plans are in the air, and so is overreach.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Jupiter: A broadly favourable climate: goodwill, opportunity and a readiness to think big make it easier to move things forward.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Jupiter: Confidence runs ahead of judgement. Promises are made easily and kept less easily, and excess of every kind is tempting.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Saturn: A sober point in the year. Authority, duty and limits are in focus, and whatever was not built properly shows it.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Saturn: Discipline and purpose cooperate. A steady, constructive climate, good for responsible decisions and work that lasts.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Saturn: Purpose meets resistance. Delays, red tape and the demands of authority make progress feel like hard work.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Uranus: A jolt in the year. Independence, defiance and sudden change are in the air, and the predictable becomes less so.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Uranus: Change comes in a usable form: fresh ideas, inventions and new ways of doing things find willing takers.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Uranus: Disruption and defiance run high. Sudden reversals, breakdowns and clashes with authority are more common than usual.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Neptune: Clarity fades and ideals rise. Compassion, art and faith are strong, and so are confusion, deception and low energy.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Neptune: Imagination and goodwill flow. A kind climate for creative work, charity and what is done for others.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Neptune: Things are not what they seem. Misinformation, wishful thinking and fatigue cloud judgement; facts are worth checking twice.
pairs.Sun|Conjunction|Pluto: Power is in the foreground. Pressure, control and what has been kept hidden come to light, and people dig in.
pairs.Sun|Flow|Pluto: Determination is strong and well directed: a good climate for deep reform, recovery and seeing hard things through.
pairs.Sun|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles intensify. Coercion, obsession and confrontations with entrenched interests are more common.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Venus: Words turn pleasant and persuasive. Diplomacy, negotiation and the arts of charm and design are favoured.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Venus: Talk is gracious and agreements come easily: a good climate for negotiating, making peace and creative writing.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Mars: Talk heats up. Arguments are quick and blunt, decisions are made fast, and words land hard.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Mars: Thinking is quick and decisive. A good climate for debate, problem-solving and getting plans moving.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Mars: Sharp tongues and hasty decisions. Arguments, angry messages and mistakes from rushing are common.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Jupiter: Big talk and big ideas. Announcements, publishing and teaching are favoured, and details get lost.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Jupiter: An open, optimistic exchange of ideas: good news travels, and learning and agreements come easily.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Jupiter: Talk outruns the facts. Exaggeration, overpromising and overlooked details are common.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Saturn: Serious, careful thinking. Contracts, plans and hard facts get attention, and the tone is cautious, even pessimistic.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Saturn: Clear, disciplined thinking. A good climate for planning, contracts and work that needs accuracy.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Saturn: Communication meets obstacles: delays, refusals, red tape and a gloomy reading of the news.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden news and flashes of insight. Ideas move fast, technology is in focus, and minds change abruptly.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Uranus: Inventive thinking finds an outlet. Original ideas, quick solutions and new technology are well received.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Uranus: Nervous, erratic communication. Technical faults, abrupt announcements and jumping to conclusions are common.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Neptune: Words blur into impressions. Poetry and imagination are strong; facts, contracts and directions are less reliable.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Neptune: Intuition helps thinking: a good climate for creative writing, music and sympathetic listening.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Neptune: Confusion and misinformation spread easily. The small print matters, and rumours and vague promises deserve caution.
pairs.Mercury|Conjunction|Pluto: Probing, intense talk. Secrets come out, research goes deep, and words are used to persuade or to control.
pairs.Mercury|Flow|Pluto: Penetrating thinking: a good climate for investigation, research and getting to the root of a problem.
pairs.Mercury|Tension|Pluto: Words become instruments of power. Propaganda, compulsive argument and the exposure of secrets are more likely.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Mars: Desire and attraction run strong. Romance, passion and the pursuit of what one wants are in the air.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Mars: Attraction and initiative work together: a warm climate for romance, art and cooperation in shared effort.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Mars: Desire meets friction. Quarrels between partners, jealousy and impulsive spending are more common.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Jupiter: Generosity and pleasure peak. Celebrations, spending and goodwill run high, and so does indulgence.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Jupiter: One of the friendliest combinations: goodwill, ease with money and a sociable mood.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Jupiter: Too much of a good thing. Overspending, overeating and promising more than is meant are tempting.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Saturn: Affection and money meet reality. Commitments are tested, budgets tighten, and the mood is reserved.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Saturn: Loyalty and good sense combine. A steady climate for lasting agreements, sound investment and faithful relationships.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Saturn: Coolness and restraint. Loneliness, austerity and relationships that feel like duties are more noticeable.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden attractions and abrupt breaks. Tastes change quickly, markets jump, and the unconventional appeals.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Uranus: Fresh tastes and unexpected pleasures: a lively climate for new friendships, novel designs and spontaneous fun.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Uranus: Instability in affection and money: sudden breakups, erratic markets and restlessness in relationships.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Neptune: Romance and idealism run high. Art, music and compassion flourish, and so do infatuation and seeing what one wishes to see.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Neptune: A tender, artistic climate. Kindness, devotion and beauty are easy to find and to give.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Neptune: Rose-tinted glasses. Disappointment in love, financial deception and unrealistic hopes are more common.
pairs.Venus|Conjunction|Pluto: Intense attraction and obsession. Love and money become questions of power, and feelings run deep.
pairs.Venus|Flow|Pluto: Deep loyalty and renewal: a good climate for transforming relationships and finances for the better.
pairs.Venus|Tension|Pluto: Jealousy, possessiveness and manipulation in love or money come to the surface.
pairs.Mars|Conjunction|Jupiter: Energy and confidence surge together. Bold ventures and large undertakings start, and so does recklessness.
pairs.Mars|Flow|Jupiter: Effort is well rewarded. Enterprise, sport and ambitious projects go well in a confident climate.
pairs.Mars|Tension|Jupiter: Overconfidence drives action. Taking on too much, reckless risks and zealous conflict are more likely.
pairs.Mars|Conjunction|Saturn: Drive meets restriction head on. Frustration, hard labour and blocked effort are common; discipline is the way through.
pairs.Mars|Flow|Saturn: Controlled, persistent effort. A strong climate for hard work, engineering and anything that needs stamina.
pairs.Mars|Tension|Saturn: Effort runs into walls. Frustration, harsh measures and mishaps from forcing things are more likely.
pairs.Mars|Conjunction|Uranus: Volatile, explosive energy. Sudden actions, mishaps and revolts are more likely, and tempers snap.
pairs.Mars|Flow|Uranus: Quick, inventive action. A good climate for bold experiments, technical work and breaking a deadlock.
pairs.Mars|Tension|Uranus: Erratic energy. Sudden conflicts, rash moves and mechanical failures are more common.
pairs.Mars|Conjunction|Neptune: Energy diffuses. Action is driven by ideals or by confusion; effort leaks away and motives are unclear.
pairs.Mars|Flow|Neptune: Effort in the service of an ideal: a good climate for charitable work, dance, film and acting on inspiration.
pairs.Mars|Tension|Neptune: Misdirected effort. Fatigue, hidden opposition and action on false information are more likely.
pairs.Mars|Conjunction|Pluto: Raw force. Intense ambition, ruthlessness and confrontations over power are in the air.
pairs.Mars|Flow|Pluto: Formidable stamina and resolve: a strong climate for demanding work, recovery and decisive change.
pairs.Mars|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles turn aggressive. Coercion, hostility and fights to the finish are more likely.
pairs.Jupiter|Conjunction|Saturn: The meeting of growth and limits that opens a new twenty-year cycle in public and economic life. Old structures are reset and new ones begin.
pairs.Jupiter|Flow|Saturn: Growth and prudence cooperate: a climate of steady, well-founded progress in institutions and the economy.
pairs.Jupiter|Tension|Saturn: Expansion and restraint pull against each other. Booms meet austerity, and institutions argue over how far to go.
pairs.Jupiter|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden opportunities and breakthroughs. Innovation, freedom and speculation are in the air, with surprising results.
pairs.Jupiter|Flow|Uranus: Progress through innovation: a climate that rewards new ideas, reform and taking a calculated chance.
pairs.Jupiter|Tension|Uranus: Overreaching for freedom or novelty. Speculative bubbles, abrupt reversals and restless demands for change.
pairs.Jupiter|Conjunction|Neptune: Idealism and faith run high. Generosity, spirituality and grand visions flourish, as do illusions and inflated hopes.
pairs.Jupiter|Flow|Neptune: A compassionate, imaginative climate, kind to charity, the arts and faith.
pairs.Jupiter|Tension|Neptune: Inflated hopes and illusions. Speculation, misplaced faith and promises without substance are common.
pairs.Jupiter|Conjunction|Pluto: Ambition on a large scale. Concentrations of wealth and power grow, and great undertakings begin.
pairs.Jupiter|Flow|Pluto: Power put to work for growth: a climate that favours large-scale renewal, recovery and long-term investment.
pairs.Jupiter|Tension|Pluto: Ambition collides with power. Excess, overreach and contests over wealth and influence.
pairs.Saturn|Conjunction|Uranus: The old order meets the new. The pull between tradition and reform is sharp, and lasting structures are reshaped.
pairs.Saturn|Flow|Uranus: Reform on a solid footing: a climate in which change can be built into lasting institutions.
pairs.Saturn|Tension|Uranus: Old and new clash. Conflicts between authority and rebellion, and between keeping things and changing them, run high.
pairs.Saturn|Conjunction|Neptune: Reality meets ideals. Dreams are tested, illusions dissolve, and beliefs have to be given a practical form.
pairs.Saturn|Flow|Neptune: Ideals find a practical shape: a climate favouring disciplined service, art with structure, and realistic vision.
pairs.Saturn|Tension|Neptune: Disillusion and uncertainty. Structures feel eroded, and it is unclear what can be relied on.
pairs.Saturn|Conjunction|Pluto: Hard pressure on institutions. Endings, crises of power and the need to rebuild from the ground up.
pairs.Saturn|Flow|Pluto: Endurance and deep change work together: a climate for serious, lasting reconstruction.
pairs.Saturn|Tension|Pluto: Severe pressure and restriction. Crises of authority and hard choices over power and resources.
pairs.Uranus|Conjunction|Neptune: A generational turn in ideals and technology. New visions of the future take root slowly across society.
pairs.Uranus|Flow|Neptune: A long background of inspired change: new ideals and new technology support each other across society.
pairs.Uranus|Tension|Neptune: A long background of unsettled ideals: confusion about where change is leading, and visions that do not hold.
pairs.Uranus|Conjunction|Pluto: A generational upheaval. Radical change and transformation run through society over years.
pairs.Uranus|Flow|Pluto: A long background of constructive transformation: deep change and innovation reinforce each other.
pairs.Uranus|Tension|Pluto: A long background of upheaval: radical change meets entrenched power, and old systems break under pressure.
pairs.Neptune|Conjunction|Pluto: A meeting that comes about once in five centuries, marking the slow turn of one long age into the next.
pairs.Neptune|Flow|Pluto: A background that runs through whole generations: a slow, quiet support between collective ideals and deep change.
pairs.Neptune|Tension|Pluto: A rare, long-running pressure between collective ideals and the forces of deep change.

dayTones.Flowing: A cooperative day in the sky. The planets' main contacts run mostly with the grain, so in general things move with less friction than usual.
dayTones.Mixed: A day of push and pull. Some of the planets' contacts ease things along while others add friction, so openings and hold-ups come side by side.
dayTones.Demanding: A demanding day. The planets' main contacts are frictional, which tends to show as pressure, impatience and obstacles; it also suits effort that has been put off.
dayTones.Focused: A concentrated day. The main contacts are conjunctions, which turn up the volume on particular themes rather than making things easier or harder.
dayTones.Quiet: A quiet day in the sky. Apart from the outer planets' long-running aspects, no planet beyond the Moon is close to an aspect, so the day takes its colour from the Moon and from what is already under way.

fastIngress.Sun: The Sun enters {sign}, and for the next month the general emphasis takes on that sign's manner.
fastIngress.Mercury: Mercury enters {sign}. For the next few weeks talk, trade and news take on that sign's manner.
fastIngress.Venus: Venus enters {sign}. For the next few weeks taste, affection and spending take on that sign's manner.
fastIngress.Mars: Mars enters {sign}. For the next several weeks drive and conflict take on that sign's manner.
fastIngress.Retrograde: {planet} goes back into {sign} while retrograde, returning to ground it had already covered.

notes.quietDay: None of the Sun, Mercury, Venus or Mars is within two degrees of an aspect today, so the day has no particular foreground beyond the Moon.
notes.noMoonContacts: The Moon makes no exact aspect to the planets today.
notes.moonContacts: The Moon passes each planet's aspects within hours, so these colour a few hours each rather than the day.
notes.positions: Where each planet stands at the middle of the day. ℞ marks a planet that is retrograde.
notes.planetaryDay: Each weekday belongs to the planet it is named for. Choose a city under Settings > Where you are to add sunrise, sunset and the planetary hours.
